title: Implement Parameterized SQL Queries
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code uses string concatenation for SQL queries, creating SQL injection vulnerabilities in banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security breach allowing unauthorized access to customer financial data and account manipulation
suggested_approach: Replace concatenated SQL with parameterized queries using Entity Framework or Dapper in C# modernization
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized statements
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in database operations
Penetration testing validates SQL injection prevention

provenance.evidence: Concatenated SQL in balance check operation

title: Add Input Validation for Financial Operations
problem_statement: Banking operations accept raw text input without validation, risking invalid monetary transactions
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid financial transactions, potential data corruption, regulatory compliance violations
suggested_approach: Implement comprehensive input validation with decimal precision, range checks, and business rule enforcement
success_criteria: All monetary inputs validated for format and range
Account number validation with checksum verification
Business rules enforced (minimum balance, transaction limits)

provenance.evidence: Direct txtAmount.Text usage in financial calculation

title: Implement Transaction Integrity Controls
problem_statement: Banking operations lack ACID transaction controls, risking data consistency in concurrent access scenarios
risk_if_unaddressed: Data inconsistency, race conditions in financial operations, potential financial losses
suggested_approach: Implement database transactions with proper isolation levels and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies
success_criteria: All financial operations wrapped in database transactions
Concurrent access testing validates data consistency

provenance.evidence: Single UPDATE statement without transaction context

title: Design Authentication and Authorization Layer
problem_statement: No visible authentication mechanism for banking operations, failing compliance requirements
risk_if_unaddressed: Regulatory violations, unauthorized access to financial systems, audit failures
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth2/OIDC with role-based access control and audit logging for banking compliance
success_criteria: Role-based permissions with least privilege principle
Complete audit trail for all banking transactions

provenance.evidence: No authentication checks in balance retrieval
No authorization validation in deposit operation
